title: MUSON: A Reasoning-oriented Multimodal Dataset for Socially Compliant Navigation in Urban Environments

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a geometrically balanced dataset with an strictly equivalent quantity of samples for left and right directions to prevent models from statistical priors that favor turning to a specific side.

Employing a Macro-averaged F1 Score metric to assign equal weight to sparse, safety-critical actions (e.g., stop, turn left) and dominant actions (e.g., move forward) to evaluate model robustness and fairness against action class imbalance.
